text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket is acting different from 
usual while eating...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... My tummy is rumbling so much, but 
I can't eat a single bite~...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been nodding off anytime, 
anywhere... At this rate, I won't be able 
to give it... my all—

...She seems to be carrying a lot of 
fatigue. We might need to reconsider her 
race schedule.
